Incoterms.hero_title: Find a suitable Incoterm for your trade scenario
Incoterms.hero_description: Use the guided, rule-based advisor or compare Incoterms in the reference guide.
Incoterms.disclaimer: For general guidance only. Confirm the selected Incoterm with your trade, legal, and insurance advisers before using it in a contract.
Incoterms.btn1_description: Answer a few questions about your shipment and receive a rule-based suggestion.
Incoterms.btn2_description: Quickly access the Incoterm cheat sheet for reference.
Incoterms.reference_guide_description: Compare Incoterms responsibilities, costs, and risk transfer points for buyers and sellers.
Incoterms.exw_use_case: Domestic trade or high-control buyer arrangement.
Incoterms.exw_risk: Buyer assumes all risk once goods are made available at the seller's premises.
Incoterms.fca_use_case: Containerized cargo where seller delivers to a terminal / carrier.
Incoterms.fca_risk: Once goods are delivered to the carrier / terminal, risk transfers to buyer.
Incoterms.fas_use_case: For sea freight where seller delivers goods alongside the vessel at the named port of shipment.
Incoterms.fas_risk: Risk of loss or damage passes to the buyer when goods are placed alongside the vessel.
Incoterms.fob_use_case: For sea freight where seller delivers goods on board the vessel nominated by the buyer.
Incoterms.fob_risk: Risk passes to the buyer once goods are on board the vessel at the port of shipment.
Incoterms.cfr_use_case: For sea freight where seller pays for transport costs to the named port of destination.
Incoterms.cfr_risk: Risk passes to the buyer once goods are on board the vessel at the port of shipment.
Incoterms.cpt_use_case: Air freight or multiple-mode shipments to a specific destination.
Incoterms.cpt_risk: Risk transfers to buyer once goods are handed over to the first carrier.
Incoterms.cif_use_case: For sea freight where seller pays for transport and insurance to the named port of destination.
Incoterms.cif_risk: Risk passes to the buyer once goods are on board the vessel; seller obtains insurance on minimum cover.
Incoterms.cip_use_case: Air freight or multiple-mode shipments to a specific destination.
Incoterms.cip_risk: Risk transfers to buyer once goods are handed over to the first carrier.
Incoterms.dap_use_case: For any mode of transport where seller delivers goods ready for unloading at the named destination.
Incoterms.dap_risk: Seller bears all risks involved in bringing goods to the named destination.
Incoterms.dpu_use_case: For any mode of transport where seller delivers and unloads goods at the named destination.
Incoterms.dpu_risk: Seller bears all risks involved in bringing goods to and unloading them at the named destination.
Incoterms.ddp_use_case: Air freight or multiple-mode shipments to a specific destination with all duties and customs cleared.
Incoterms.ddp_risk: Seller bears all risks and costs involved in bringing goods to the destination, including import duties and customs clearance.
Incoterms.advisor_intro: Every global trade journey begins with clear roles. Answer three core questions to calibrate your advisor.
Incoterms.advisor_q1_title: Are you the Seller (Exporter) or the Buyer (Importer)?
Incoterms.advisor_q1_seller_desc: Responsible for dispatching goods and providing documentation.
Incoterms.advisor_q1_buyer_desc: Responsible for receiving goods and managing import formalities.
Incoterms.advisor_q2_title: Is this an International or Domestic shipment?
Incoterms.advisor_required_error: Please answer all three questions before continuing.
Incoterms.advisor_s2_description: Describe the intended responsibility split so the rule-based advisor can suggest an Incoterm to review. Your choices affect cost and risk allocation.
Incoterms.advisor_s2_resp1_question: Do you want to handle export customs?
Incoterms.advisor_s2_resp2_question: Do you want to manage international freight?
Incoterms.advisor_r_official_source: Review the official ICC Incoterms® 2020 information
